figures.title: 示例查询的几个部分
figures.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT v.*,CASE WHEN due_date>='2025-12-31' THEN 'current' WHEN due_date>='2025-12-01' THEN '01-30' WHEN due_date>='2025-11-01' THEN '31-60' WHEN due_date>='2025-10-02' THEN '61-90' ELSE '90+' END bucket FROM v_invoice_balance v WHERE balance_cents>0) SELECT supplier_id,bucket,COUNT(*) invoices,SUM(balance_cents) outstanding_cents FROM a GROUP BY supplier_id,bucket ORDER BY outstanding_cents DESC

parts.label: 中间结果
parts.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT v.*,CASE WHEN due_date>='2025-12-31' THEN 'current' WHEN due_date>='2025-12-01' THEN '01-30' WHEN due_date>='2025-11-01' THEN '31-60' WHEN due_date>='2025-10-02' THEN '61-90' ELSE '90+' END bucket FROM v_invoice_balance v WHERE balance_cents>0)
parts.note: 先单独算出一张临时结果 a，下面的查询可以把它当作普通表来用。

parts.label: 来源
parts.note: 数据来自中间结果 a。

parts.label: 分组

figures.title: 应付账款账龄：按到期日分档，再汇总欠款（以供应商 11 的发票为例）

stages.label: ① 处理前：还有余额的发票（只统计正余额）

tables.sql: SELECT supplier_invoice_id, due_date, balance_cents FROM v_invoice_balance WHERE balance_cents>0 AND supplier_invoice_id IN (292,574,1162,1176,1259,1565,3633,4412) ORDER BY due_date DESC, supplier_invoice_id

stages.label: ② 按到期日（不是开票日）归入账龄区间
stages.via: 固定截止日 2025-12-31：到期当日未逾期；其余按逾期天数分成 1–30、31–60、61–90、90 天以上

tables.sql: SELECT supplier_invoice_id, due_date, balance_cents, CASE WHEN due_date>='2025-12-31' THEN 'current' WHEN due_date>='2025-12-01' THEN '01-30' WHEN due_date>='2025-11-01' THEN '31-60' WHEN due_date>='2025-10-02' THEN '61-90' ELSE '90+' END bucket FROM v_invoice_balance WHERE balance_cents>0 AND supplier_invoice_id IN (292,574,1162,1176,1259,1565,3633,4412) ORDER BY due_date DESC, supplier_invoice_id

stages.label: ③ 同一区间的发票合并：数发票张数、加欠款
stages.via: GROUP BY 账龄区间：COUNT(*) 数张数，SUM(余额) 加欠款

tables.sql: SELECT bucket, COUNT(*) invoices, SUM(balance_cents) outstanding_cents FROM (SELECT balance_cents, CASE WHEN due_date>='2025-12-31' THEN 'current' WHEN due_date>='2025-12-01' THEN '01-30' WHEN due_date>='2025-11-01' THEN '31-60' WHEN due_date>='2025-10-02' THEN '61-90' ELSE '90+' END bucket FROM v_invoice_balance WHERE balance_cents>0 AND supplier_invoice_id IN (292,574,1162,1176,1259,1565,3633,4412)) GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY MIN(CASE bucket WHEN 'current' THEN 0 WHEN '01-30' THEN 1 WHEN '31-60' THEN 2 WHEN '61-90' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END)

figures.conclusion: 账龄看的是合同到期日；各区间互斥且覆盖所有有效到期日，部分付款只统计剩余金额。
